researchQuestion: How does tree density affect bounded four-neighbor fire spread in a finite forest?
scope: Local unverified Python adaptation of NetLogo Fire 7.0.4 on a fixed non-wrapping 31 by 31 world
mechanisms: unconditional ignition of the full left boundary
irreversible burning and finite ember fading
assumptions: fire cannot cross an empty cell
the left boundary ignition is excluded from initial_trees and burned_trees

initial_trees.description: Green trees remaining immediately after the full left boundary is ignited

burned_trees.description: Cumulative trees ignited after setup; excludes the forced left boundary

burn_fraction_pct.description: 100 times burned_trees divided by initial_trees; zero when initial_trees is zero

limitations: Python random.Random and row-major initialization do not reproduce NetLogo RNG or per-seed worlds
This candidate has no native NetLogo replay or cross-implementation equivalence evidence
Browser Preview is local and unverified; it is not a Verified Experiment or research result
The fixed 31 by 31 world and at most 80 ticks are conservative preview output bounds
